name: FollowCamera::slot63 zero preset
reason: Retail VC6 zeros EAX once and fans it out to three stores; modern clang emits three immediate-zero stores.

name: FollowCamera::slot70 mode/state toggle
reason: Control flow and member accesses are strongly reconstructed, but clang chooses different register allocation and branch/code shapes.

name: FollowCamera::slot72 cyclic state-list advance
reason: Retail preserves explicit increment/store/compare/wrap loads; modern P6-target clang uses CMOV. Pentium-target clang removes CMOV but still optimizes the sequence more aggressively than retail VC6.

name: FollowCamera::slot68 bounded distance-derived parameter
reason: Natural C++ reproduces the recovered math/data flow and is within 2 bytes of retail size, but x87 scheduling/comparisons differ heavily from VC6.

name: FollowCamera::slot69 cached 12-byte virtual return
reason: VehicleCamera slot 57 confirms MSVC hidden return-buffer ABI for a 12-byte by-value return plus one float argument; clang copies/caches the value with different stack/security/codegen.

name: FollowCamera::slot71 state dispatcher
reason: State 0-4 dispatch and snapshot/save-restore behavior agree; clang collapses the switch into a computed virtual offset rather than VC6's per-case calls/jump-table shape.
